title: AUDO-SIGHT: ENABLING AMBIENT INTERACTION FOR BLIND AND VISUALLY IMPAIRED INDIVIDUALS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing multimodal large language model (MLLM) responses with and without the implementation of NeMo Guardrails to measure the reduction of inaccessible visual directions, vague answers, and patronizing language ('Admiring Beauty in a Way that Evokes Pity') directed at Blind and Visually Impaired (BVI) individuals.
